description:
PathAI's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI-powered pathology. 

PathAI is transforming traditional pathology methods into powerful, new technologies. These innovations in pathology can help accelerate drug development, improve confidence in the accuracy of diagnosis, and get life-saving therapies to patients more quickly. At PathAI, you'll work with a diverse and talented team of people, who are dedicated to solving complex problems and making a huge impact. 

We're looking for a skilled staff level Site Reliability Engineer focused on designing, architecting, and operating our cloud-native and multi-cloud deployment substrates, environment configurations, and delivery and deployment infrastructure across diverse environments - including connected and air-gapped on-premises setups, as well as customer-managed and PathAI-managed cloud environments.

The Opportunity

  • Advancing the state of our operations by implementing SRE best practices - focusing on users, monitoring, and automation.
  • Designing, building, and owning our deployment substrates, including core environment definitions, delivery plumbing, and infrastructure configuration management across multi-cloud, on-premises (both connected and air-gapped), and customer-managed cloud environments.
  • Architecting secure, compliant, multi-account cloud environments adhering to NIST, ISO, and SOC2 standards.
  • Integrating cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines with internal developer platforms, connected/air-gapped on-premises customer environments, and hybrid cloud targets.
  • Improving the reliability and resilience of our infrastructure through root-cause analysis and reviewing gaps in designs, and implementations of our infrastructure.
  • Participating in platform on-call rotations and assisting with urgent incident response.

Who You Are:
(Required)

  • You have 8+ years of relevant experience.
  • You have deep expertise with multi-cloud platform architectures, identity and access management, and multi-environment network topology.
  • You have a proven track record defining infrastructure and deployment substrates as code using modern IaC tools Timz(Terraform, Crossplane) and GitOps practices (ArgoCD) across Kubernetes clusters, cloud environments, and hybrid/on-prem infrastructure.
  • You have extensive experience managing container orchestration platforms at scale (EKS/Kubernetes/K3s) and building self-service environment templates for engineering teams across cloud and on-premises deployment targets.
  • You have strong software engineering background in languages such as Python, Go, or Bash for building platform tooling, automation pipelines, and infrastructure plumbing.
  • You have experience building key signal infrastructure with modern observability tools (Datadog/Grafana/Prometheus).
  • You work hard to eliminate toil by automating environment provisioning, deployment workflows, and configuration management.
  • You’ve managed critical production infrastructure and are familiar with incident response, scaling, and rapid growth related challenges to operating multi-cloud and on-prem environments.
  • You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • You have an insatiable intellectual curiosity and the ability to learn quickly in a complex space.

This is a hybrid position based in Boston (preferred), NYC, Indianapolis. (A remote option may be considered for an exceptional candidate.)
Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location Boston, MA is $146,250 - $225,000.  Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.  

PathAI is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. The company's policy prohibits unlawful discrimination, including but not limited to, discrimination on the basis of Protected Veteran status, individuals with disabilities status, and consistent with all federal, state, or local laws.
